how: We read the website of every Kansas City wedding videographer listed on Lazo (84 listings, 70 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: DJ and production companies with no film work, a national chain's landing pages, a longtime filmmaker who says he is no longer booking weddings, photo booth rentals, and an officiant service. Fewer than a dozen true wedding film studios had readable sites, so this list stops at eight.. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who captures audio from the vows and toasts, and how is it recorded when the ceremony is outdoors in wind or beside a highway?
What arrives and when: a highlight film, the full ceremony and toasts as separate videos, raw footage, and in what resolution?
If photo and video come from the same team, who runs the timeline on the day, and how do the two crews share the couple's time?

picks.name: Baysinger Films
picks.blurb: Baysinger Films has served Kansas City for more than ten years and says it is more interested in who you are and why you are marrying than in the details of the day. Highlight films and full-length edits, with package starters and investment listed on the site.

picks.name: Davinshi Visuals Weddings
picks.blurb: Davinshi Visuals makes timeless, classic wedding films meant to be passed down, and its site lists featured films by venue, from Milburn Country Club to the Grand Hall at Power and Light. Packages include timeline collaboration with your planner and photographer and private online 4K delivery.

picks.name: Her Third Eye Productions
picks.blurb: Her Third Eye Productions calls its work visual heirlooms rather than wedding films, custom fit to each love story. The filmmaker traces the approach to her own family, who gather over old photos and videos and swap stories until early morning.

picks.name: The Real Brides
picks.blurb: The Real Brides of Kansas City films your wedding as the season finale of your love story, with confessionals from the couple and bridal party. Packages list separate videos of the full ceremony, first dances, toasts and cake cutting.

picks.name: Epic Photography
picks.blurb: Epic Photos + Films shoots photos and films as one small team, with more than ten years of weddings behind it. Lee's Summit based, covering Kansas City and all surrounding areas, with a pitch built on energy, direction and a stress-free day.

picks.name: Aventi Weddings - Photography, Videography, and Coordination
picks.blurb: Everything at Aventi Weddings is handled in-house by one team of photographers, videographers and coordinators, so the day feels seamless. Editorial at heart, documentary by nature, in their words, serving Kansas City and worldwide.

picks.name: BGstudios Photography
picks.blurb: Brandi's BGstudios in Kansas City pairs photography with film under one roof, focusing on the emotional connections of the day rather than a shot list. Weddings and elopements, with collections described on the site.

picks.name: Beau Vaughn Photography, Videography, Photobooth, DJ & Planning
picks.blurb: Beau Vaughn in Olathe bundles videography with photography, photobooth, DJ and coordination, with more than ten years of wedding experience and Best of The Knot and Couples' Choice listed on the site. Serves Kansas, Missouri and destination weddings, with a multiple-service discount.
